name: io.github.agigante80/actual-mcp-server
title: Actual Budget MCP Server
description: Manage Actual Budget accounts, transactions, budgets, rules and reports from an AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Actual Budget server, for example https://actual.example.com

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_SYNC_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sync ID of the budget (Actual: Settings, Advanced settings)

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: End-to-end encryption password, for an encrypted budget only. Requires an https:// ACTUAL_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BRIDGE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of a user-private directory for the local budget cache

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The same raw value as MCP_SSE_AUTHORIZATION

token.description: The same raw value as MCP_SSE_AUTHORIZATION: raw token, no Bearer prefix

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Actual Budget server; must be reachable from inside the container

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_SYNC_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sync ID of the budget (Actual: Settings, Advanced settings)

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: End-to-end encryption password, for an encrypted budget only. Requires an https:// ACTUAL_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SSE_AUTHORIZATION
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token clients must send: raw token, no Bearer prefix; generate with openssl rand -hex 32
